Lessons.title: Math
Lessons.description: Learn maths from the basics to advanced topics to whatever you're learning. We can help you understand the content and get good marks.

Lessons.title: Coding
Lessons.description: Learn to code in many languages such as html, css, javascript, python and many more such as go. We can help you get through your semester of digitech or learn a coding language for fun.

Lessons.title: German
Lessons.description: Learn german from scratch or from your level. We can help you through the subject or the immersion program, as members of our team has lots of experience with the language.

Lessons.title: Arts

Lessons.title: Science
Lessons.description: We can help you through any science subjects in year 7-8, and help you grasp the content and get good marks.

Lessons.title: History
Lessons.description: We can help you through HASS essays and help you learn about what you're focusing on in class.

Lessons.title: English
